sentences.en: We were on The Office together, and we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》，而且我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为您带来终极的《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节以及许多闺蜜之间的故事。

sentences.en: Angela, are you ready for some jump scares?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你准备好迎接惊吓了吗？

sentences.en: Maybe some eerie music and a really scary villain?
sentences.zh: 也许还有些诡异的音乐和一个真正可怕的反派？

sentences.en: Why would I be ready for any of that?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要准备好迎接这些？

sentences.en: But you better get ready, because today we're breaking down the webisode, The Third Floor,
sentences.zh: 但你最好准备好，因为今天我们要解析网络剧集《三楼》，

sentences.en: which is all about Ryan making a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 讲的是瑞安拍恐怖电影的故事。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I know you're very excited for today's episode.
sentences.zh: 好吧，珍娜，我知道你对今天的剧集非常兴奋。

sentences.en: You love a good horror movie.
But I want to tell you, I'm just thankful that there are no zombies in this one,
sentences.zh: 但我得告诉你，我很庆幸这一集里没有僵尸，
因为我真的很讨厌僵尸。

sentences.en: I mean, Ryan tried to have zombies.
sentences.zh: 我是说，瑞安确实尝试过加入僵尸。

sentences.en: This is one thing you and I do have in common, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这倒是你我之间的一个共同点。

sentences.en: What do we have in common?
Well, I don't know if we should talk about it, but we both had a really strong reaction
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道我们该不该提，但我们俩对

sentences.en: to the season of The Last of Us.
sentences.zh: 《最后生还者》那一季的反应都非常强烈。

sentences.en: You know, Josh had me watch it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是乔什让我看的。

sentences.en: He wanted me to watch it.
How did Josh get you to even start watching this?
sentences.zh: 乔什是怎么让你开始看这部剧的？

sentences.en: You watched the whole first season.
sentences.zh: 你可是看完了整整第一季。

sentences.en: I was very excited, because this is our first zombie crossover moment.
sentences.zh: 我当时很兴奋，因为这是我们第一次聊到僵尸题材。

sentences.en: Well, we all love Pedro Pascal, which is why this season was so very upsetting to us,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们都喜欢佩德罗·帕斯卡，这就是为什么这一季让我们如此难过，

sentences.en: because we didn't play the video game, everybody.
sentences.zh: 因为大家，我们没玩过那个电子游戏。

sentences.en: We didn't know what was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And after it happened, I was so upset.
sentences.zh: 事情发生后，我难过极了。
珍娜给我留了三条语音。

sentences.en: If you don't know the video game, and if you haven't watched this show yet, just like—
sentences.zh: 如果你没玩过这款游戏，也没看过这部剧，那么——

sentences.en: Fast forward, because I actually need to talk about this.
sentences.zh: 快进吧，因为我真的得聊聊这个。

sentences.en: And I know we're a little late to talking about it, because everyone expressed this same
sentences.zh: 我知道我们聊得有点晚了，因为大家在两个月前
就已经表达过同样的愤慨了。

sentences.en: But truly, if you haven't played the video game, and you haven't seen season two,
sentences.zh: 但说真的，如果你没玩过游戏，也没看过第二季，

sentences.en: just fast forward about 50 seconds from now.
Guys, Pedro Pascal's character has the most gruesome death in episode two.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，佩德罗·帕斯卡饰演的角色在第二集里死得太惨了。
我当时心想，等等，什么情况？

sentences.en: She's going to come rescue him.
Why would I keep going out with a guy who broke my heart like that?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要继续和一个伤透我心的男人交往呢？

sentences.en: Like, the show is a man who I was in love with, and he f***ing trampled on my heart.
sentences.zh: 这部剧就像是一个我深爱的男人，他妈的把我的心给践踏了。

sentences.en: I can't go back to him.
sentences.zh: 我没法再回到他身边了。

sentences.en: I can't go back to him.
sentences.zh: 我没法再回到他身边了。

sentences.en: It was too much for me.
And I sent a text to our group thread where I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我给我们的群组发了条信息，问这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You gave me three, like, angry messages.
sentences.zh: 你给我发了三条特别愤怒的信息。

sentences.en: Like, angry, long messages about what the hell just happened here.
sentences.zh: 就是那种愤怒的长篇大论，问这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Yeah, we both were pretty bummed about that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们俩当时都挺难受的。

sentences.en: Josh is still watching, so he has continued without me.
sentences.zh: 乔什还在看，所以他没我陪着也继续看下去了。

sentences.en: I was like, babe, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 我说，宝贝，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: You can't ask me, as someone who hates zombies.
sentences.zh: 你不能要求我，作为一个讨厌丧尸的人，

sentences.en: You can't ask me to watch a zombie show with the one thing that kept me watching it.
sentences.zh: 你不能要求我继续看一部丧尸剧，而我坚持看下去的唯一动力，

sentences.en: That was the only reason I was there.
sentences.zh: 那是我看这部剧的唯一理由。

sentences.en: It wasn't the only reason I was there, but I am so distraught that I have not been able
sentences.zh: 那倒不是我看的唯一理由，但我实在太难过了，以至于
我根本没法继续看下去。

sentences.en: I think I will get over this hurt.
sentences.zh: 我想我会从这次伤害中走出来的。

sentences.en: I was trying to explain it to Lee, because Lee doesn't watch it with me.
sentences.zh: 我当时试着跟李解释，因为李不跟我一起看。

sentences.en: He's like, I don't get, like, just this one person died.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不明白，怎么就死了一个人而已。

sentences.en: I'm like, babe, babe, it's Pedro Pascal, okay?
sentences.zh: 我说，宝贝，宝贝，那可是佩德罗·帕斯卡，好吗？

sentences.en: He is like, I tried to come up with, like, an analogy.
sentences.zh: 他说，我试着想出一个类比。

sentences.en: I was like, he is, remember what Meg Ryan was to, like, an 80s romantic comedy movie?
sentences.zh: 我说，他就是，你还记得梅格·瑞恩对于80年代浪漫喜剧电影意味着什么吗？

sentences.en: Just, like, an utter delight from the moment she's on screen until the end.
sentences.zh: 就是那种从她出现在银幕上那一刻起，直到电影结束，都让人感到无比愉悦的存在。

sentences.en: Like, just makes you happy watching her.
sentences.zh: 就是看着她就会让你感到开心。

sentences.en: That is the feeling I get when I watch Pedro Pascal in anything.
sentences.zh: 这就是我看着佩德罗·帕斯卡出演任何作品时的感觉。

sentences.en: You know what it is for me?
sentences.zh: 你知道对我来说这意味着什么吗？

sentences.en: Whatever he's in, I'm so invested.
sentences.zh: 无论他演什么，我都深陷其中。

sentences.en: I still really, really need you to see his arc in Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 我还是非常、非常希望你能看看他在《权力的游戏》里的角色弧光。

sentences.en: I really need you to get to Dorne.
sentences.zh: 我真的需要你看到多恩那个篇章。

sentences.en: I saw a red carpet interview with him where someone said,
sentences.zh: 我看到过一个他的红毯采访，有人问他，

sentences.en: will you ever have such a brutal death as you had in Game of Thrones that will upset fans?
sentences.zh: 你以后还会像在《权力的游戏》里那样死得那么惨，让粉丝们伤心吗？

sentences.en: And he said, yes, I think there will be, because he knew what was going to happen in The Last of Us.
sentences.zh: 他说，会的，我想会的，因为他当时已经知道《最后生还者》里会发生什么了。

sentences.en: I still need you to see him in Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 我还是需要你去看看他在《权力的游戏》里的表现。

sentences.en: Yeah, I need you to watch that episode at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 对，我至少需要你去看看那一集。

sentences.en: I don't want to just tune in to see him die.
sentences.zh: 我不想只为了看他死才去追剧。

sentences.en: You need to see the minute he comes on screen.
sentences.zh: 你需要看看他出现在银幕上的那一刻。

sentences.en: His presence, it's so different from the other characters you've seen him play.
sentences.zh: 他的那种气场，和他之前演过的其他角色完全不同。

sentences.en: I need you, I need you to see him.
sentences.zh: 我需要你，我需要你去看看他。

sentences.en: My introduction to him was in Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 我最初认识他是在《权力的游戏》里。

sentences.en: Okay, my introduction to him was in Narcos.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我最初认识他是在《毒枭》里。
噢，他在《毒枭》里演得太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay, I will watch Game of Thrones for Pedro Pascal.
sentences.zh: 好吧，为了佩德罗·帕斯卡，我会去看《权力的游戏》的。

sentences.en: I mean, could she just pick up with that season, Sam?
sentences.zh: 我是说，她可以直接从那一季开始看吗，萨姆？

sentences.en: She doesn't have to, like, watch all the way to when they have the Dorne brother sisters on.
sentences.zh: 她不需要非得一直看到多恩那些姐妹们出场吧。

sentences.en: So he first appears in season four, episode one.
sentences.zh: 他是在第四季第一集首次登场的。
我说就直接看那一季吧。

sentences.en: I got pretty far into Game of Thrones when I committed to watching it.
sentences.zh: 我当初下定决心看《权力的游戏》时，已经看了挺长一段了。

sentences.en: Like, I'm pretty sure, I've told you, like, when is that red lady on that extra island?
sentences.zh: 我记得我跟你说过，就是那个在额外岛屿上的红袍女是什么时候出现的？

sentences.en: Isn't that, like, in season three or something?
sentences.zh: 那不是在第三季左右吗？

sentences.en: You're not talking about the red wedding.
You're talking about the red lady who had sex with the black smoke.
sentences.zh: 你指的是那个和黑烟发生关系的红袍女。

sentences.en: I don't know what season that is, but that was around where it lost me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是第几季，但大概就是在那儿我看不下去了。

sentences.en: I would pick up, I would start season three.
I would watch season three and then treat yourself with a first episode of season four at the end.
sentences.zh: 我会看完第三季，最后再看一集第四季的第一集犒劳一下自己。

sentences.en: Have you seen the red wedding episode?
sentences.zh: 你看过“血色婚礼”那一集吗？

sentences.en: I don't know what happens in a red wedding.
sentences.zh: 我不知道血色婚礼里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, we might have to make a list for her.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们可能得给她列个清单。

sentences.en: We should probably take a break because when we come back, we are going to break down the third floor.
sentences.zh: 我们大概该休息一下了，因为回来之后，我们要剖析一下三楼。

sentences.en: And Jenna, as our resident horror movie expert, you're going to give us your assessment of Ryan's attempt at this genre.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，作为我们的常驻恐怖片专家，你要给我们评价一下瑞安对这个类型的尝试。

sentences.en: I tried to give it my best critique.
sentences.zh: 我试着给出了我最好的评价。
我给安吉拉布置了一个任务。

sentences.en: I asked her to watch the first 24 minutes and 30 seconds of John Carpenter's The Thing.
sentences.zh: 我让她看了约翰·卡朋特执导的《怪形》的前24分30秒。

sentences.en: Because that is about the same amount of time that I watched the first John Wick movie on my first viewing.
sentences.zh: 因为那和我第一次看第一部《疾速追杀》时看的时间长度差不多。

sentences.en: But Angela said she would watch that same length of any horror movie I chose.
sentences.zh: 但安吉拉说她愿意看我选的任何恐怖片，只要时长一样就行。

sentences.en: And I have no idea what her reaction is.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道她的反应会是什么。

sentences.en: But I cannot wait to hear your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 但我迫不及待想听听你的想法了。

sentences.en: And Angela, I want you to know that I tried really hard to pick a movie that was not just a horror movie, but also a classically great film.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我想让你知道，我真的很努力地选了一部电影，它不仅是恐怖片，也是一部经典的伟大电影。

sentences.en: I didn't just try to, like, give you some slasher scary thing.
sentences.zh: 我不是只想随便给你找个吓人的砍杀片。

sentences.en: I truly knew nothing about this movie before I watched it.
sentences.zh: 在看这部电影之前，我真的对它一无所知。

sentences.en: I did not look it up.
I really watched it not knowing anything.
sentences.zh: 我真的是在什么都不知道的情况下看的。

sentences.en: So it was just my honest reaction as I started watching it.
sentences.zh: 所以这完全是我刚开始看时的真实反应。

sentences.en: And I will share that with you.
Attention all new and existing members of the WDNC.
sentences.zh: 请注意，所有WDNC的新老成员。

sentences.en: I'm Melanie Sanders, and this is the We Do Not Care Club podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是梅兰妮·桑德斯，这里是《我们不在乎俱乐部》播客。

sentences.en: We got to midlife and realized we just simply do not care much anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们步入中年，意识到自己真的没那么在乎了。

sentences.en: Now, we got to help each other make sense of hot flashes, itchy ears, chin hair, trifling families, brain fog, and bat wings.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们要互相帮助，去理解潮热、耳朵痒、下巴长毛、琐碎的家庭、脑雾和蝴蝶袖这些事。

sentences.en: We are not alone, and we will be heard.
sentences.zh: 我们并不孤单，我们的声音会被听见。
所以，加入“我们不在乎俱乐部”（WDNC）吧。

sentences.en: Follow and listen to the We Do Not Care Club podcast with Melanie Sanders wherever you get your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 在各大播客平台关注并收听梅兰妮·桑德斯主持的《我们不在乎俱乐部》播客。

sentences.en: And this webisode series has some really fun bonus content on Peacock.
sentences.zh: 这个网络剧集系列在孔雀视频（Peacock）上有一些非常有趣的额外内容。

sentences.en: Like, there is this cool black and white film slipbook of behind the scenes of this shoot.
sentences.zh: 比如，有一本很酷的黑白幕后花絮翻页书，记录了这次拍摄的过程。

sentences.en: It was really fun to watch.
There's also some interviews with the caSt.
I thought we should kick this off with what Mindy and BJ had to say about this webisode series.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该先从敏迪和BJ对这个网络剧集的评价开始。

sentences.en: The episodes are following the tradition of the characters wanting to put on a show.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集延续了角色们想要表演节目的传统。

sentences.en: Ryan is directing a horror film that he thinks will be sort of the paranormal activity set in an office.
sentences.zh: 瑞安正在导演一部恐怖片，他认为这会是那种以办公室为背景的《灵动：鬼影实录》式的电影。

sentences.en: Picked up by the documentary crew and by the main characters in the office.
sentences.zh: 由纪录片摄制组和办公室里的主角们拍摄。

sentences.en: Like, the little things that fall through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 就像那些容易被忽略的小事。

sentences.en: I think that's the best thing to show in a webisode.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是网络剧集最适合展现的内容。

sentences.en: So I really liked when the group did Subtle Sexuality, that girl band that Kelly and Erin did.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢之前那个组合做的“微妙性感”（Subtle Sexuality），就是凯莉和艾琳组成的那个女子乐队。

sentences.en: And I really liked this horror film that they're all working on.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢他们现在正在制作的这部恐怖片。

sentences.en: It's funny, like, the side projects that just get completely ignored by everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，就像那些在办公室里完全被大家忽视的副业项目。

sentences.en: And somehow, for the webisodes, we capture them.
sentences.zh: 而不知何故，我们在网络剧集里捕捉到了它们。

sentences.en: So it's really fun that they get to explore what Ryan's passions or hobbies are.
sentences.zh: 所以能探索瑞安的爱好或热情所在，真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And I guess he's a big horror film fan.
sentences.zh: 我猜他是个恐怖片大影迷。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's more that he's a filmmaking fan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得与其说是影迷，不如说他是个电影制作迷。

sentences.en: And this, to me, kind of goes with his character trait of, like, how he got into photography for a while.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这和他的人物性格很契合，就像他之前有一阵子迷上摄影一样。

sentences.en: I feel like the horror movie part is just his way into being a, like, film director.
sentences.zh: 我觉得拍恐怖片只是他成为电影导演的一种途径。
好了，还有更多的演员访谈。

sentences.en: We'll sprinkle those in as we go.
sentences.zh: 我们会在节目进行过程中穿插播放。

sentences.en: Well, here are a few stats about this webisode.
sentences.zh: 那么，这里有一些关于这个网络剧集的数据。

sentences.en: This was during Season 7 of The Office.
sentences.zh: 当时正值《办公室》第七季期间。

sentences.en: We aired the episode costume contest the same day as this webisode.
sentences.zh: 我们在播出这一网络剧集的同一天，播出了剧集《服装竞赛》。

sentences.en: It was kind of our nod to Halloween.
sentences.zh: 这算是我们对万圣节的致敬。

sentences.en: This webisode was also nominated for a Webby Award.
sentences.zh: 这个网络剧集还获得了威比奖提名。

sentences.en: So episode one is titled Kelly and Erin Move On.
sentences.zh: 第一集的标题是《凯莉和艾琳向前看》。

sentences.en: This whole series of webisodes were written by Kelly Hannon, Jonathan Hughes, and Mary Wall.
sentences.zh: 这一整个系列的网络剧集是由凯莉·汉农、乔纳森·休斯和玛丽·沃尔编写的。

sentences.en: And they were directed by Mindy Kaling.
Kelly and Erin are going to pivot away from subtle sexuality.
sentences.zh: 凯莉和艾琳打算从“微妙性感”转型。

sentences.en: They're not going to make music anymore.
Their new creative outlet is going to be acting in Ryan's horror film.
sentences.zh: 她们新的创意出口将是出演瑞安的恐怖片。

sentences.en: As the series starts, we are at front reception.
sentences.zh: 剧集开始时，我们在前台。

sentences.en: Kelly and Erin are listening to the tail end of their song, I'm Just the Girl Next Door.
sentences.zh: 凯莉和艾琳正在听她们歌曲《我只是邻家女孩》的结尾部分。

sentences.en: Erin thinks it's their best one yet.
sentences.zh: 艾琳认为这是她们迄今为止最好的一首歌。

sentences.en: But they are disappointed by how many views the video is getting.
sentences.zh: 但她们对视频的观看量感到失望。

sentences.en: Dare I say it's the two of them watching it?
sentences.zh: 我敢说是因为他们两个在看吗？

sentences.en: Kelly declares that music and dance are dead.
sentences.zh: 凯莉宣称音乐和舞蹈已经死了。

sentences.en: Erin does add it's also the economy.
sentences.zh: 艾琳补充说还有经济原因。

sentences.en: They say maybe it's time to move on.
sentences.zh: 她们说也许是时候向前看了。

sentences.en: They're not giving up on fame.
They're just giving up on music.
So we cut to a little sitting area outside the break room.
sentences.zh: 镜头切到休息室外的一个小休息区。

sentences.en: Kelly and Erin are now with Kevin.
sentences.zh: 凯莉和艾琳现在正和凯文在一起。

sentences.en: They are sitting on the floor.
Yes, like a little brainstorming session.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像一场小型的头脑风暴会议。

sentences.en: I've never seen this staging before.

sentences.zh: 这部电影里没有任何垃圾CGI特效。

sentences.en: I have to give a shout out to the special effects guy.
sentences.zh: 我必须得向特效师致敬。

sentences.en: And he was only 22 years old when he did the effects for this movie.
sentences.zh: 他做这部电影的特效时才22岁。

sentences.en: He also did the effects for Total Recall.
sentences.zh: 他还负责了《全面回忆》的特效。

sentences.en: You know that scene in Total Recall where the lady's face splits open?
sentences.zh: 你知道《全面回忆》里那个女人的脸裂开的场景吗？

sentences.en: But the practical effects in this are nuts.
sentences.zh: 但这部电影里的实景特效简直疯了。

sentences.en: How about the scene where, I'm sure you didn't see it coming.
sentences.zh: 还有那个场景，我敢肯定你没预料到。

sentences.en: I don't know how you made it through it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是怎么坚持看完的。

sentences.en: When they go to do the, like, the ka-junk of the CPR on the guy who, like, has the heart attack.
sentences.zh: 就是他们去给那个心脏病发作的人做心肺复苏，那个“咔哒”一下的时候。
他们做了那个“咔哒”的动作。

sentences.en: And then you know what happens.
sentences.zh: 然后你就知道会发生什么了。

sentences.en: His whole chest opens up and, like, a giant mouth, like, eats off the hands of the person who was doing the ka-junk.
sentences.zh: 他的整个胸腔裂开，就像一张巨大的嘴，把那个正在操作机器的人的手给吃掉了。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter that I've told you.
sentences.zh: 就算我告诉你了也没关系。

sentences.en: It's still going to f***ing kick your ass when you see it.
sentences.zh: 等你亲眼看到的时候，还是会把你吓个半死。

sentences.en: But, honestly, the part when the dog exploded and then all the little things came out of him was worse for me.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，对我而言，那只狗爆炸然后钻出许多小东西的片段更让我受不了。

sentences.en: I could handle whatever else that thing had coming for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我就能承受那东西接下来对其他人做的一切了。

sentences.en: The way it does absorb other people is so disgusting.
sentences.zh: 它吸收其他人的方式真是太恶心了。

sentences.en: And the one guy on roller skates keeps, like, finding people's clothes ripped.
sentences.zh: 还有那个穿轮滑鞋的家伙，一直在发现别人被撕碎的衣服。

sentences.en: And he's like, hey, you guys, do a better job cleaning up.
sentences.zh: 他还说，嘿，你们几个，打扫得干净点。
我就想，他们都已经死了。

sentences.en: And what I also really liked about this movie was just how much time and patience the director had.
sentences.zh: 而且我非常喜欢这部电影的一点是，导演投入了大量的时间和耐心。
他没有仓促处理任何一个瞬间。

sentences.en: And then I thought the ending was just so good.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得结局处理得太棒了。

sentences.en: It does not wrap up with a bow.
sentences.zh: 它并没有给出一个圆满的结局。

sentences.en: It also has a little bit of, like, that survivalist aspect to it.
sentences.zh: 它还有一点那种生存主义的色彩。

sentences.en: I'm always interested in things that are set in wilderness or, like, the cold, you know.
sentences.zh: 我一直对那些以荒野或寒冷环境为背景的故事很感兴趣，你懂的。

sentences.en: I love that it's just this, the isolation of these people, you know.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这种与世隔绝的感觉，你懂的。

sentences.en: Oh, one of the comments I didn't share was the very first time I saw the giant ice cube.
sentences.zh: 噢，我没分享过的一条评论是，我第一次看到那个巨大的冰块时。

sentences.en: I was like, giant ice cube, probably holds some kind of Frankenstein thing.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，巨大的冰块，里面大概装着什么弗兰肯斯坦之类的东西吧。
不过说真的，这电影很棒。

sentences.en: Thank you for suggesting it and not making me watch those other ones.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你推荐这部，没让我去看那些其他的片子。

sentences.en: That would have been too much for me.
sentences.zh: 那些对我来说实在太受不了了。

sentences.en: Well, I just have to say, lady, now that we know that I have watched Lord of the Rings
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得说，女士，既然我们都知道我已经看过《指环王》了，

sentences.en: I'm not sure there was much more about this movie that was more gory or terrifying than,
sentences.zh: 我不确定这部电影里还有什么比这更血腥或更恐怖的，

sentences.en: like, an orc being born in Lord of the Rings.
sentences.zh: 比如，《指环王》里半兽人出生那一段。

sentences.en: The way they kind of plop down in that gelatinous, like, giant mud hole.
sentences.zh: 它们那种掉进黏糊糊的、像巨大泥坑里的样子。

sentences.en: What is it about horror movies you don't like?
sentences.zh: 你到底是不喜欢恐怖片的哪一点？

sentences.en: Because it can't be the violence and the gore.
sentences.zh: 因为肯定不是因为暴力和血腥。

sentences.en: Because you watch very violent stuff all the time.
sentences.zh: 因为你一直都在看非常暴力的东西。

sentences.en: Narcos, Game of Thrones, Lord of the Rings.
Like, what is it that you don't like?
sentences.zh: 所以，你到底不喜欢什么？

sentences.en: I don't like waiting for the jump scare.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢等待那种跳跃式惊吓。

sentences.en: Okay, so, like, and that makes sense to me because a lot of the violence in Game of Thrones,
sentences.zh: 好吧，这我能理解，因为《权力的游戏》里很多暴力场面，

sentences.en: Yeah, when I see a battle scene, I'm like, okay, they're here to fight.
sentences.zh: 是啊，当我看到战斗场面时，我会想，好吧，他们是来打仗的。

sentences.en: But if I'm just walking into my kitchen late at night, pour myself a glass of milk,
sentences.zh: 但如果我只是深夜走进厨房，给自己倒杯牛奶，

sentences.en: and then I open the fridge, and then I shut it, and there's a guy there!
sentences.zh: 然后我打开冰箱，关上冰箱，结果那儿站着个人！

sentences.en: Also, one of the things, like, right at the beginning of this movie, there's this,
sentences.zh: 还有，其中一点是，就在电影刚开始的时候，

sentences.en: for no reason, an establishing shot of a big tank of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 无缘无故地，给了一个大汽油桶的空镜头。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, they're going to need that.
sentences.zh: 我就想，噢，他们待会儿肯定用得上。

sentences.en: What do they need the gasoline for?
Well, my heart is so happy.
sentences.zh: 哎呀，我心里真是太高兴了。

sentences.en: Thank you for the gift of watching this movie and for liking it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你送我这份礼物，让我看了这部电影，也谢谢你喜欢它。

sentences.en: I did not know if you—I mean, I just didn't expect you to like it, but I'm so glad you did.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你——我是说，我只是没想到你会喜欢，但我真的很高兴你喜欢。

sentences.en: Jenna, we're just, like, in our friendship, we're just encouraging each other to grow and
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我们只是，在我们的友谊中，我们只是在鼓励彼此成长，

sentences.en: This is a really exciting year.
sentences.zh: 今年真是令人兴奋的一年。

sentences.en: We're in our 50s, and look at us.
sentences.zh: 我们都五十多岁了，看看我们。

sentences.en: This should prove to anyone it's never too late to experience something new.
sentences.zh: 这应该向所有人证明，体验新鲜事物永远都不晚。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, everyone, for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 那么，谢谢大家今天加入我们。

sentences.en: I love this webisode, and I love today's episode.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这期网络节目，也喜欢今天的剧集。

sentences.en: And thank you to Ellie Kemper for always answering my crazy text messages.
sentences.zh: 还要感谢艾丽·坎伯总是回复我那些疯狂的短信。

sentences.en: And we hope you guys have a great week.
sentences.zh: 希望大家这周过得愉快。
